test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following is a combination reaction?

(i) ZnCO₃ (s) → ZnO (s) + CO₂ (g)

(ii) Mg (s) + 2HCl (aq) → MgCl₂ (aq) + H₂ (g)

(iii) 2KBr (aq) + BaI₂ (aq) → 2KI (aq) + BaBr₂ (s)

(iv) H₂ (g) + Cl₂ (g) → 2 HCl (g)
solution:
The correct answer is __**(iv).**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A combination reaction is a type of chemical reaction where **two or more substances combine** to form a **single new substance.**
 
• In other words, it is a reaction where the** reactants combine** to form a product.
 
• is a **combination reaction** as hydrogen and chlorine combine to form** hydrochloric acid.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ZnCO3 (s) → ZnO (s) + CO2 (g) is a **decomposition reaction **as zinc carbonate breaks down into zinc oxide and carbon dioxide.
 
• 2KBr (aq) + BaI2 (aq) → 2KI (aq) + BaBr2 (s) is a **double displacement reaction **as the positive and negative ions of two compounds switch places to form two new compounds.
 
• Mg (s) + 2HCl (aq) → MgCl2 (aq) + H2 (g) is a **single displacement reaction** as magnesium replaces hydrogen in hydrochloric acid to form magnesium chloride and hydrogen gas.
 
• It is important to identify the type of reaction as it helps in **predicting the products of the reaction** and understanding the underlying chemistry.
